name: Lavender
use: Scent for the wardrobe, a feast for bees.
description: Lavender is a woody perennial with grey-green leaves and tall spikes of purple flowers. It needs full sun and well-drained soil, and it is best trimmed lightly after flowering. The flowers are used in the wardrobe, in baking and in tea, and bees visit them all summer.
imageAlt: Five lavender stems topped with spikes of purple flowers.
